mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before consulting a contractor about a granny flat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before booking an initial consultation, gather a property survey or plot plan showing your property boundaries, easements, and current structures. Determine your primary goals, such as who will live in the space and whether they need specialized mobility accommodations like walk-in showers. Establish a realistic overall budget, and identify your electrical service panel and primary sewer cleanout locations to help the estimator assess utility tie-ins. Having this property information organized helps your contractor quickly evaluate feasibility and recommend appropriate construction approaches.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather a property survey, note your budget and mobility requirements, and identify key utility connection points like your electrical panel and main plumbing lines.
